Air Hockey by Ludovic Dupont (korial29)
Upstream: https://github.com/korial29/air-hockey
Pinned upstream tree: https://github.com/korial29/air-hockey/tree/6627de2d20b1ce8a62627cb0211e5475d2adf47d
License: Apache-2.0. See the accompanying verbatim LICENSE.txt. Upstream's current public root lists LICENSE and no NOTICE; no upstream NOTICE was recorded for the pinned snapshot in the original integration.

The authoritative Room JavaScript bundle in this directory was built
from unmodified upstream Room source. room.js re-exports the built
assets module. The separate Willowbrook server adapter calls the Room
over the authenticated Willowbrook transport; this does not make the
upstream Room bundle a modified file.

The original integration used the pinned upstream TypeScript and
lockfile, with npm ci --ignore-scripts and BUILD_SERVER=true during the
Vite production build. The separately packaged browser client carries
its own per-file modification notices. The repository-level Willowbrook
license does not replace Apache-2.0 here.
